text: Fifty gaming legends. Name every shadow.
Mario! He started out as Jumpman.
Pikachu! Its name is a spark plus a squeak.
Pac-Man! Legend says he's a pizza missing a slice.
Bowser! In Japan, he's called Koopa.
Yoshi! He debuted in Super Mario World.
Luigi! He began life as Mario in green.
Donkey Kong! Mario's very first enemy.
Steve! Minecraft is the best-selling game ever.
Kirby! Born as a placeholder blob called Popopo.
Angry Birds! Rovio's fifty-second game. Fifty-one came first.
Crash Bandicoot! Naughty Dog's PlayStation mascot.
Mega Man! He steals boss powers.
Link! Not Zelda. Everyone mixes that up.
Master Chief! His Spartan number is one-seventeen.
Lara Croft! Gaming's first big action heroine.
Scorpion! "Get over here!" started with him.
Chun-Li! Street Fighter's first playable woman.
Ryu! The original Street Fighter hero.
Spyro! A purple dragon from nineteen ninety-eight.
Pac-Man! Nineteen eighty. A year before Donkey Kong.
Rayman! No arms. No legs. No problem.
Princess Peach! Once called Princess Toadstool.
Creeper! Born from a coding mistake.
Wario! His name means bad Mario.
Level two cleared. Score in comments. Hard mode.
Charizard! He's not even a Dragon type.
Fox McCloud! Star Fox's ace pilot.
Cloud Strife! Final Fantasy Seven's spiky-haired soldier.
Kratos! He went from Greek gods to Norse.
Samus Aran! Metroid's big twist: she's a woman.
Nintendo 64! Three handles, one analog stick.
Solid Snake! A cardboard box. Still works.
Doom Slayer! Doom came out in nineteen ninety-three.
Sans! Undertale was made mostly by one person.
Geralt of Rivia! Born in Polish fantasy novels.
Arthur Morgan! Voiced by Roger Clark.
Gordon Freeman! He never speaks. Not once.
Nathan Drake! Claims he descends from Sir Francis Drake.
Sephiroth! His theme is One-Winged Angel.
Warning! Expert mode. Most people fail here.
Trevor Philips! Voiced by Steven Ogg.
Fact! Sony and Nintendo built it. Then Nintendo quit.
Ezio Auditore! Star of three Assassin's Creed games.
Sly Cooper! A raccoon thief on PlayStation Two.
The Konami Code! Thirty lives in Contra.
Joel Miller! Voiced by Troy Baker.
Hornet! Fans begged for her own game. Silksong delivered.
The Knight! Hollow Knight's silent hero.
Number fifty. Comment your guess! The answer is pinned. Subscribe!
